properties.name: A cut ends by rebuilding the release binary this box serves, then stopping every shared daemon
properties.statement: After release_report confirms the release is out and its assets are verified, run tools/reflow2-rebuild.sh and stop every shared daemon (--stop-shared per project, or a full restart of those sessions; a /mcp reconnect does not replace a running server). Confirm with pgrep -fa target/release/reflow2-mcp and ls -l /proc/<pid>/exe: (deleted) means that server is still the old build. Why: the user-scope registration serves target/release with no launcher in the path, so nothing else tells other projects' sessions the binary is behind. Measured 2026-09-18: a real building design was adopted on 0.62.0 for a whole session while 0.64.0 was published.
